name: Golden Wok Express
address: Unit 4, Northgate Plaza (behind the bank, next to the tax place), 11740 Old Kettering Pike Frontage Road, Meadowbrook Commons
about: My parents opened Golden Wok Express in 1987 on Delaware Ave and we moved here in 2004 when they put up the plaza. There are 214 items on the paper menu and all of it is still cooked in the back by hand. My mother still makes the wonton soup. Most people call the phone, which is fine with us.
announcement: WE ARE OPEN. The app says 40 minutes but it is usualy faster if you call. Only some of the 214 items are on here — if you want a number that is not listed please call (330) 555-0148 and ask for Danny. Cash is still preferred but the card machine works again.

reviews.name: Ramona V.
reviews.text: We have been ordering from Golden Wok since they were on Delaware and I want to say something about it. The boneless spare ribs are the same as they were when I was in high school, exactly the same, and the woman who makes the wonton soup asked about my son by name last month. Forty minutes is nothing. I would wait two hours. The modifier screen is insane and I pay it every single time.

reviews.name: Jeff D.
reviews.text: Ordered the 114 and it came out of the wok so hot it warped the container. Danny told me I should have gotten the 121. Danny was right.

reviews.name: Tyler S.
reviews.text: There is nowhere to park in this plaza. Two spots and the tax place takes both of them. Food was great but I am rating the parking.

reviews.name: Meiling C.
reviews.text: Charged me $1.10 to not put meat in the fried rice. Owner explained it is a separate pan and honestly that tracked.

reviews.name: Doug A.
reviews.text: I called three times and nobody picked up and then I found out I was calling the wrong restaurant. Leaving this up.

reviews.name: Priya N.
reviews.text: The egg drop soup description is in all capital letters warning you about the lid and I ignored it and I want everyone to know it was my own fault. Five stars. The soup was excellent, in my car.
